TITLE:
Rahul Gandhi Gives Traders 30‑Second Plan to End Ramlila Maidan Protest

DESCRIPTION:
Rahul Gandhi told traders how to end the Ramlila Maidan protest in 30 seconds.
Traders warned the protest involves about a million people and 20,000 vehicles, causing gridlock; they said the rally could cost them Rs 10,000 crore and want it postponed. VHP urged opposition to stop targeting Hindu festivals and the economy. #RahulGandhi #RamlilaMaidan #Traders #VHP
